entities.name: Frost Marsh
entities.description: A blackened swamp in northern Terisiare near Tresserhorn, a graveyard used by Lim-Dûl to incubate undead.

entities.name: Ronom Lake
entities.description: Lake that dried up as the glacier grew, becoming the marsh.

entities.name: Ronom Glacier
entities.description: Growing glacier whose meltwater no longer fed Ronom Lake.

entities.name: Tresserhorn
entities.description: Dark keep of Lim-Dûl near which the marsh formed.

entities.name: Lim-Dûl
entities.description: Necromancer who incubated undead in the marsh and sent them against Kjeldor.

entities.name: Kjeldor
entities.description: Realm attacked by Lim-Dûl's undead battalion.

entities.name: Thaw
entities.description: End of the Ice Age after which the land flooded.

entities.name: Flooding of Terisiare
entities.description: Event that covered the marsh with seawater.

entities.name: Sea of Laments
entities.description: Sea that eventually completely submerged the marsh.

entities.name: Ice Age
entities.description: The era in which the marsh existed.

events.summary: Ronom Lake dries up, turning the surrounding land into a swamp.
events.quote: the land around it turned into a swamp

events.summary: Lim-Dûl uses the marsh to incubate undead followers.
events.quote: used by Lim-Dûl to incubate his undead followers

events.summary: Near the end of the Ice Age Lim-Dûl calls a battalion of undead from the lake to attack Kjeldor.
events.quote: Lim-Dûl called a battalion of undead from the lake, sending it to attack Kjeldor .

events.summary: After the Thaw, the Flooding of Terisiare submerges the marsh under the Sea of Laments.
events.quote: it was eventually completely submerged by the newly formed Sea of Laments

relations.note: formed near the base of the keep
relations.quote: The Frost Marsh formed near the base of the dark keep of Tresserhorn
